limits: Old binary baseline uses commit 2f72bdd4, not the current master parent; the runs are characterization, not controlled causal memory A/B.
Reuse mode retains growing normal conversation history; RSS growth alone is not proof of a leak.
Linux Host-only, loopback fake model, under one minute per run; no multi-hour, real-model load or native Windows/macOS memory certification.
Full-trace queue byte budget and other JSON pipeline redesigns remain outside this focused PR.
